camp.about: Match Hammer gems to charge a hit on one cell.

well.about: Water buckets earn 3 Food each from expedition 5.

quay_steps.about: The Workshop's first tread opens the way to the viewing shutter.

workshop.about: Cut blocks earn 5 Supplies each. The first tread repairs the quay steps.

market.about: Adds ration jars to later expeditions.

gateway.about: Helmets replace sun coins, 6 Coins each.

lodge.about: Adds grain bundles worth 5 Food each.

archive.about: Adds carved quartz worth 7 Supplies each.

observatory.about: Upgrades Star to Star II so it can hit through one layer of chain or ice.

log_cabin.about: Upgrades Hammer to Dynamite. The Blast slot keeps its charge.

map_room.about: Match Plus gems to add a quarter charge to your other unlocked bonuses.

water_mill.about: A two-stage cascade can bring a miller to the working mill.

clock_tower.about: Match Star gems to charge a hit on every piece of one kind.

lighthouse.about: Upgrades Shield to Lightning. Hit a row and strike up to 20 cells in total.

amphitheater.about: Shield gems join later expeditions. Match them to charge a row strike.

museum.about: Harps replace sandals and earn 10 Coins each. Plus II gives the other unlocked bonuses a half charge.
